subject: general
question: What is the primary focus of Mission Shakti 5.0 launched by Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Women's safety, dignity, and self-reliance**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mission Shakti 5.0** was officially launched by **Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath** on **October 3, 2024**, to coincide with the auspicious occasion of **Shardiya Navratri**.
 
• The primary focus of this phase is to strengthen the three pillars of women's empowerment: **safety (Suraksha)**, **dignity (Samman)**, and **self-reliance (Swavalamban)** across the state of **Uttar Pradesh**.
 
• A major highlight of **Mission Shakti 5.0** is the mobilization of **Shakti Didis**, who are female government officials and volunteers who visit **gram panchayats** and urban **wards** to bridge the gap between the government and women citizens.
 
• The mission aims to provide a secure environment by strictly enforcing laws against perpetrators of crimes against women and ensuring that help is accessible through dedicated helplines such as **1090 (Women Power Line)** and **112 (Emergency Response Support System)**.
 
• The campaign also emphasizes **self-reliance** by encouraging women to participate in **Self-Help Groups (SHGs)** and educating them on how to benefit from various state-led economic initiatives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Evolution of the Mission:** The **Mission Shakti** initiative was first introduced in **October 2020** as a multi-phase campaign to address gender-based violence and promote female empowerment in **India's** most populous state.
 
• **Financial Empowerment:** One of the key schemes linked to this mission is the **Mukhya Mantri Kanya Sumangala Yojana**, which provides a financial incentive of **Rs 25,000** (increased from **Rs 15,000** in **2024**) to support the health and education of girl children.
 
• **Institutional Support:** To ensure effective implementation, **Mission Shakti Booths** have been established in all **1,528 police stations** in **Uttar Pradesh**, providing a safe space for women to report grievances without hesitation.
 
• **Social Security:** The state government utilizes this platform to promote the **Destitute Women Pension Scheme**, which provides monthly financial assistance to **widows** and women in economic distress to ensure their **dignity** is maintained.
 
• **Impact and Data:** Since its inception, the mission has contributed to **Uttar Pradesh** achieving a high **conviction rate** in cases related to crimes against women, demonstrating the effectiveness of integrated policing and judicial monitoring.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Inter-departmental Cooperation:** The success of **Mission Shakti 5.0** relies on the coordination of **27 government departments**, including **Home**, **Women and Child Development**, **Basic Education**, and **Secondary Education**.
 
• **Technology Integration:** The **Safe City Project**, integrated under the broader umbrella of **Mission Shakti**, uses **CCTV surveillance** and **AI-based analytics** in public places to enhance the real-time **safety** of women in major cities.
 
• **Awareness Drives:** Special programs are conducted in schools and colleges during the **9-day** festival of **Navratri** to educate young girls about **good touch and bad touch**, cyber safety, and their legal rights under the **POCSO Act**.
